raw_records.text: Boutique pilates studio in Austin. Book by DM on Instagram. 6 instructors. Classes fill fast; waitlist handled by text message.
Founded 2021 by Maya R. We answer every message personally, usually within a day.

output.what_they_do: A boutique pilates studio in Austin running small-group classes with six instructors.
output.how_they_operate: Bookings arrive by Instagram DM and are confirmed manually. The waitlist is run over text message. The site states messages are answered personally, usually within a day, which implies no booking system in front of the schedule. Inference: payments are likely handled ad hoc at class or by payment link, since no online checkout is visible.

Class demand exceeds supply (classes fill fast), so every filled class implies a burst of DM triage, manual confirmations, and waitlist shuffling that a booking system would absorb.
